settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer:
Inside Dhaka: 1-2 days
Outside Dhaka: 2-3 days

We deliver all over Bangladesh.

settings.question: What are the delivery charges?
settings.answer:
Inside Dhaka: 80 Tk
Sub Dhaka: 100 Tk
Outside Dhaka: 120 Tk

An additional 50 Tk is added if the parcel weighs over 1 kg.

settings.question: What condition are the clothes in?
settings.answer: Every piece is inspected, cleaned, and steamed before being listed. We grade our items transparently and mention any minor signs of wear, fading, or vintage distressing directly in the product description.

settings.question: How do I know if an item will fit me?
settings.answer: Because vintage and international sizing varies widely, do not rely solely on the tag size. Check the exact flat-lay measurements (Chest/Pit-to-Pit and Length in inches) listed in every product description and compare them against a jacket you already own.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange my order?
settings.answer:
You can check the product in front of the delivery man and return it by paying only the delivery charge.

If a major issue is found later, you can exchange it for a different product within 7 days.

settings.question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
settings.answer:
If you receive the wrong item or a major flaw that was not mentioned in the product description:

  1. Record a clear unboxing video from the moment you open the sealed parcel.
  2. Contact us within 24 hours of delivery via WhatsApp or Instagram DM (@ajairathrift) with your order number and unboxing video.
  3. Once verified, we will arrange a full refund or free return pickup.

settings.question: Can you restock a sold-out item?
settings.answer: Since our pieces are thrifted and individually sourced, we cannot restock the exact same item once it sells out.

settings.question: How do I remove wrinkles?
settings.answer: Wipe it with a damp cloth and let it hang somewhere to reduce the wrinkles. Overall they will go away as you wear it.
